additional_concerns: Definition correspondence does not validate the complete relief rule. For node.1bf6918f69c6b37738daeb83, node.4e6a162c35678e9ddf17ad8e, node.ce439b1cf9ed8301fbb68f94 and node.ea4d19630f8cab09065b1909, preservation of existing application processing is converted into a substantive relief exclusion. That inference is not expressly established by the supplied circular; preservation of procedure without substantive disqualification remains an unresolved alternative.

The explicit Effective Date supports commencement on 28 November 2025, but the introductory immediate-effect wording and the legally relevant assessment event require reconciliation before treating these formulas as complete temporal rules. The circular does not expressly establish a universal implementation-date test.

The relevant SFC FAQs, including the revamped FAQ on SFC Authorization of UCITS Funds, are missing and needed to resolve actual procedural availability and transition treatment. The two supplied missing dependency IDs have no identifying metadata permitting a reliable match to those authorities.

Applicable home-jurisdiction requirements and guidance on novel or complex features and possible local policy implications are not supplied. The formulas accept these classifications as inputs; they do not establish them. Their absence does not undermine the circular's express fund definition.

Node.4d548f2e09bc36ef51212f64 excludes legacy applications from its question, while node.b66b3e831bb98a12db59dffa assesses substantive conditions only. Neither answers actual relief availability for a preserved legacy application. Node.8eb374ffa546ddd2ba291e37 retains that unresolved question without executable meaning.
